# Benchmark evidence (generated by bench/make_evidence.py)

Machine: Apple M5 Pro, 24 GB, macOS 26.5; Stata/MP 17.0 (2-core license). Times are end-to-end seconds (master in memory, using on disk → joined data in memory), median of 3 reps at N=10M and 5 at smaller N. `hmerge` = prototype v0.2 (hash / direct-address join, master order kept); `hmerge_sort` = same + `sort` option to reproduce merge's key order. frames = frame create + use + frlink + frget (first pass only). Pass-1 (v0.1) numbers are kept for the v0.1→v0.2 comparison.
